assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: A NEW DEDICATED SINGLE STATIC BATTLE SPRITE CANDIDATE for a native Godot tactical fantasy RPG, not a resized portrait and not a character illustration.
Reference image 1 role: original project selected character appearance ONLY. Redraw her identity/costume into NEW compact game-sprite proportions and battle stance. Do not reproduce the reference composition or long fashion-illustration proportions.
Style: exquisite 16-bit fantasy / tactical JRPG pixel art with consciously designed pixel clusters. Plan a logical 128 by 160 pixel canvas and enlarge it exactly 8x nearest-neighbor to a 1024 by 1280 PNG for delivery. EVERY logical pixel is one flat 8x8 square, consistent pixel grid. No subpixel strokes, smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, painterly shading, texture noise, tiny glitter, mosaic filter, or smooth anime rendering. Controlled 24-32 colors, selective dark purple/brown outlines, hue shifted 3-4 tone material ramps. Clear eyes and coherent hair locks must remain readable as a 160px-high sprite.
Composition: exactly ONE full-body clearly ADULT heroine, standing idle ready for side-view automatic combat, 3/4 view facing RIGHT. Adult tactical game proportions about FOUR heads from chin to boot baseline (hat/weapon excluded), capable graceful grounded stance, normal torso and legs rather than chibi baby or long fashion legs. Full body, both boots on same horizontal baseline, complete weapon visible; 10-12 logical pixels transparent margin at ALL sides including weapon tip. No duplicates, panels, inset portraits, text, watermark, symbols floating outside her hands, floor, shadow, background, particles or aura. Real transparent alpha, no baked checkerboard or backdrop, opaque character interior and clean hard-edged transparency. Separate hand/weapon/hair/cape silhouettes with clear negative space. Character sprite only; contact shadow will be drawn by the game. Modest covered practical outfit. Prioritize face, hair, main costume masses and weapon silhouette over embroidery.
Character identity: MA moon-court mage. An adult woman with rich plum-purple hair arranged in 3 large flowing locks to waist, amber eyes and a calm focused expression. Retain broad indigo witch hat with one gold crescent, ivory high-collar blouse, short indigo shoulder mantle, plum/indigo layered knee-length skirt panels, opaque dark leggings, brown ankle/knee boots and small gloves. Keep ivory cloth, violet fabric and old gold distinct. Simplify dozens of stars/chains from the reference into only 2-3 large meaningful accents. Pose: right gloved hand grips one slender crescent-topped staff just in front of her, shaft diagonally slight toward right, gold crescent around a small blue crystal. Left hand open near chest in a restrained ready-to-cast gesture; no glowing magic. Boots apart, weight centered, staff not overlapping face. Hat does not hide amber eye. New compact dedicated battle drawing, not the original tall portrait.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE seamless-looking static WIDE BATTLE BACKGROUND for a native Godot 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG, environment only.
Canvas: ultra-wide landscape approximately 3:1 (1536x512 requested), entire composition visible. Detailed crafted pixel art with crisp stepped architectural edges, coherent square clusters and economical texture; not a smooth painted illustration, not 3D or vector. Atmospheric controlled color ramps. No character, no creature, no humanoid statue, no weapon, no text, no lettering, no borders, no interface, no item icons, no UI panel.
Composition for gameplay: side-on horizontal battle stage, near-orthographic slight elevated perspective. Bottom quarter is one continuous flat traversable STONE FLOOR running left to right; clear stable horizontal standing plane with subtle tile joins. No steps, holes, low walls, tall grass or objects on the character standing plane. Two characters will later stand near 25% and 75% of canvas width with feet at about85% height. Those two vertical standing lanes need calm dark/desaturated midground, moderate value separation and few thin lines so face/hair/weapons will not be hidden. Avoid bright objects or pillar edges through those lanes. Three readable depth layers: soft low-contrast distant architecture/sky, quieter midground pillars/arches, the stable textured near ground. Architectural detail and interest mainly at far left/right edges and distant center. Keep environment beautiful and story-rich but less contrasted/saturated than player sprites; no foreground obstruction, dramatic vignette or particle shower. Background fully opaque.
Setting: MOON COURT / ASTRONOMICAL CLOISTER for a plum-haired witch in indigo, ivory and old gold. Elegant moon-white limestone terraces under a clear deep indigo night sky, a small distant crescent moon, restrained old-gold astrolabe shapes high in far central architecture, thin violet vines confined to outer columns. Far view of quiet blue mountain silhouettes and a silver night garden through arches. Muted teal/blue-purple stone shadows, pale moonlit edge light from upper left, subtle warm brass lamps only at scene edges. Lower floor is muted cool gray-lavender tile, slightly darker than ivory clothes, no engraved bright circles. At x25% a dark blue-violet midground recess lets purple hair and ivory sleeves read. At x75% similar quiet midground for a wooden training target. Ground contact positions unobstructed. A beautiful calm fantasy academy courtyard with visible depth, never a gothic horror dungeon or forest.
